correctness.rationale: For each site-availability table with all four cells positive and independent equal-rate exponential arrival clocks, conditional race enumeration gives A_j=u F_j-q F_j^2/2 and B_j=v F_j-q F_j^2/2. When u differs from v, ratios of the first two cause contrasts yield z=e^{-rT}, and explicit nonsingular linear inversions recover q,u,v and the table. When u=v, consecutive increments form c z^(j-1)+e z^(2(j-1)) with positive c,e and Hankel determinant ce(z-z^2)^2>0. Four windows recover z from the unique positive root of z+z^2=S, then recover the table. Two exact positive rational models with z=1/2 and 3/5 have identical cause-label laws at the first three deadlines but different fourth-window laws and opposite latent covariance signs. The fractions were independently recomputed from the observation law; check.py passed exact assertions and 19,419 randomized numerical inversions. The numerical checks do not substitute for the universal algebraic argument. Strict positivity and equal rates are indispensable to the stated domain.

originality.rationale: The combined sharp two-versus-four fixed-window identifiability law and explicit three-window opposite-association alias for a two-species first-consumer resource model was not located in inspected papers or indexed mathematical research. It is not claimed that all individual algebraic tools are new: the positive four-window exponential reconstruction is a Prony/Hankel specialization. Nakashima et al. (2024) treat time-to-detection with independent species and competitor censoring, whereas this theorem admits arbitrary joint presence and retains only endpoint winner labels. Recurrent-event, misidentification occupancy, and general current-status competing-risk literatures differ in the precise observations/hypotheses; broad historical priority is provisional.
residual_risks: The parametric current-status competing-risk papers and misidentification occupancy paper were not fully readable in the accessed representations; a stronger uninspected result could subsume part or all of the special-case theorem.

Classical Prony/structured exponential-sum identification directly covers the four-window algebra; novelty is restricted to the exact ecological observation law, the balanced-versus-unbalanced minimal window distinction, and the three-window opposite-association witness.

The theorem holds for exact population probabilities and identical exponential rates only. Finite-sample noise can make the inversion ill-conditioned near marginal balance and small Hankel determinants.

value.rationale: This is a motivated exact monitoring-design classification for species competing for ephemeral ecological resources, not an arbitrary numerical slice. It determines the sharp number of winner-label-only exposure durations needed to recover a hidden two-species association; an exact counterexample proves that three durations can be observationally identical even with one model indicating species avoidance and the other aggregation. Four suffice for every strictly positive table, and two suffice generically, which is useful for deciding when coarse recording can reveal ecological co-occurrence without exact timestamps. The restriction to constant identical exponential encounter rates and the lack of finite-sample precision analysis are explicitly acknowledged; no empirical significance or downstream conservation policy is assumed.
